title: FairWind-napoli97

authors.role: 5.0 indexed-colour engine, sound, multiplayer and playability update
authors.name: Claude Code (Anthropic)

controls.action: Ease or trim the sheets (takes over from auto trim for a moment)
Hoist or drop the spinnaker; confirm in menus
Hoist or drop the gennaker; back in menus
Race menu: resume, auto trim, retire, restart

technology: PRG32 1.8 portable cartridge in the 128 KiB execution-RAM profile, position independent
256-entry indexed colour: per-race sky, sea and panorama palettes graded to the time of day, palette-cycled sun glitter
PRG32 four-player multiplayer snapshots with dead-reckoned remote yachts and lobby syndicate arbitration
fixed-point perspective renderer with a stern chase camera, camera-space clipping and sun-lit, back-face-culled hulls
procedural 12-Metre hulls, trimmed sails, spinnaker and gennaker
ORC 12mR polars with sail-plan, trim and momentum models
deterministic oscillating wind shifts shared by every console
tactical AI: timed starts, VMG, shift and layline tacking, give-way manoeuvres
automatic top view in close quarters and a race-field map
row-compressed indexed Bay panoramas, logo and trophy
basic World Sailing rules and penalty turns
20-instrument synth: six songs, and wind, water, surf, winch, luff, horn and gun effects driven live by the race
legal: Fictional fan work. Il Moro di Venezia V is used only as a historical visual reference; no real sponsor marks or exact livery are reproduced. No affiliation with America's Cup Event Authority or any real syndicate. America's Cup is referenced descriptively.
